
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/19974284" title="发布于 2026-05-05 10:21">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">10. LangChain开发核心技巧，动态切换AI大模型参数</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>在 AI 应用开发中，若需动态切换大模型、调整温度等参数，可通过 init_chat_model 函数的 configurable_fields 核心配置字段实现。它支持在运行时动态修改模型参数，可基于配置规则精准控制参数的开放修改边界，配置生效后函数将返回 _ConfigurableModel 可配置模型实例，支撑全链路调用环节的参数动态调整。</p>
<p>如果喜欢看视频学习的，可以看这个<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1S29xBxER4/" rel="noopener nofollow">《10. LangChain开发核心技巧，动态切换AI大模型参数》</a>，喜欢看文章的接着往下看。</p>
<p>configurable_fields 的默认值为 None，对应关闭所有动态配置；传入字面量 'any' 时开放全量参数的动态修改权限；传入 list[str] / tuple[str, ...] 字符串序列时，仅开放显式声明的参数的修改权限。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">init_chat_model(
  model: str </span>| None =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None,
  </span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  model_provider: str </span>| None =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None,
  configurable_fields: Literal[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">any</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] | list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None,
  config_prefix: str </span>| None =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None,
  </span>**kwargs: Any =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}
) </span>-&gt; BaseChatModel | _ConfigurableModel</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260502085706937-338762530.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>在 AI 大模型的参数配置体系中，90% 的常规业务场景，仅需配置model、temperature和max_tokens三个核心参数，即可完成模型的基础调用配置。</p>
<p>完成参数配置后，可直接通过invoke()方法调用 AI 大模型，接收并获取模型生成的回复结果。</p>
<p>若需灵活调整参数，我们可通过with_config()方法，在完整保留原有基础配置的前提下，快速修改目标参数并生成全新的模型实例；该实例无需额外冗余配置，同样可直接通过invoke()方法完成调用。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.chat_models <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> @老陈说编程 今日头条 哔哩哔哩</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">load_dotenv()
config_llm </span>= init_chat_model(model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">qwen3.6-plus</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                             model_provider</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                             base_url</span>=os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">QWEN_BASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                             api_key</span>=os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">QWEN_API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
                             configurable_fields</span>=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">temperature</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">max_tokens</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
                             temperature</span>=0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                             max_tokens</span>=200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
response </span>= config_llm.invoke(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你好，请用一句话介绍自己</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(response.content)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> * 50<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 切换大模型</span>
llm_plus =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> config_llm.with_config(
    configurable</span>={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">model</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">deepseek-v4-pro</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">temperature</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 0.4, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> max_tokens</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: 100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
)
response </span>= llm_plus.invoke(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你好，请用一句话介绍自己</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(response.content)</pre>
</div>
<p>以下为.env 环境配置文件的内容，记得必将其中的 API_KEY 占位值，替换为您自行在对应平台申请的有效API密钥。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>QWEN_API_KEY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你申请的API KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
QWEN_BASE_URL</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
